content: We have mass spec showing m/z 182.073... likely molecular ion M+? The formula C13H10O has exact mass: C13=13*12=156, H10=10*1.007825=10.07825, O=15.994915 => total 182.073165 approx matches m/z 182.07316494187. So the mass spec matches C13H10O. So candidate is benzophenone (diphenyl ketone) which is O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2. That SMILES we used. Need to confirm with NMR maybe. Let's get proton NMR for that SMILES.
